continuity_validation_checklist: Does the protagonist keep consistent psychological history and voice?
Does this book resolve one major wound loop introduced or reinforced earlier?
Does the ritual section avoid medical claims and keep trauma-aware language?
Are primary and secondary keywords naturally present in title, subtitle, description, and back-cover copy?
Does the ending open a clean narrative bridge to the next volume?
